ledger.quote: In light of this, we are adding a second pharma intermediate plant at an investment of INR180 crore to come up at our Dahej site, which is expected to be commissioned in the next 8 months.
ledger.speaker: Ashish Bharat Ram
ledger.target: Add second pharma intermediate plant for INR180 crore
ledger.verdict: The eight month timeline for the pharma intermediate plant is pending as it extends beyond Sep 2026.

ledger.quote: So in that sense, the capex for financial year '27 also remains on a strong wicket.
ledger.speaker: Ashish Bharat Ram
ledger.verdict: FY27 capex target remains pending as the financial year has not concluded.

ledger.quote: If you could help us understand, they seem to be slightly dichotomous. We have to look at it from the perspective that the fourth quarter is based on a lot of deferment that has happened over quarter 2 and quarter 3.
ledger.speaker: Ashish Bharat Ram
ledger.verdict: Q4 FY26 revenue reached INR4615 crore and PAT reached INR582 crore, showing better performance.
ledger.evidence: Q4 FY26 revenue INR4615 crore, PAT INR582 crore compared to Q3 FY26 revenue INR3713 crore, PAT INR433 crore.

ledger.quote: At the moment, broadly speaking, the pharma business is, maybe in the region of close to 10% of our total specialty chemicals business; and we’ve always said that we want this to go to atleast 20%.
ledger.speaker: Ashish Bharat Ram
ledger.target: Grow pharma business to 20% of specialty chemicals
ledger.verdict: Growing pharma to 20 percent of specialty chemicals has no deadline and remains pending.

ledger.quote: As things stand right now, we're pretty much on track for that. We believe the registration for one of them has happened, so we should see the launch in the coming year.
ledger.speaker: Ashish Bharat Ram
ledger.target: Launch active ingredient in coming year
ledger.verdict: Launch of the active ingredient in the coming year is pending.

read: There is too little settled yet to judge management reliability as only one promise is graded kept while four remain pending. The eight month timeline for the pharma intermediate plant falls due next.
questions: When will the second pharma intermediate plant at Dahej be commissioned?
What is the current percentage share of the pharma business within specialty chemicals?
bull: Revenue increased to INR4904 crore in Sep 2026 from INR3640 crore in Sep 2025.
PAT reached INR509 crore in Sep 2026 compared to INR388 crore in Sep 2025.
bear: Borrowings stand at INR5375 crore with a debt to equity ratio of 0.35.
Operating profit margin declined to 19 percent in Sep 2026 from 25 percent in Jun 2026.
